_comment: Watchlist + reference nodes for the demo. Events themselves are NOT hand-written — see events[].permit_id below, which run.ts resolves to real, live Chicago building-permit records (data.cityofchicago.org, no auth) via src/sources/permits.ts. historical_velocity is a stated modeling assumption (prior known openings for that brand, before this permit), not fabricated Mireye/Exa data — see CLAUDE.md and scripts/author-fixtures.ts for how it's combined with this live signal to score expansion velocity.
_reference_nodes_note: Real last-mile distribution/warehouse buildings inside Chicago city limits (Kinzie Industrial Corridor, Pilsen Industrial Corridor, and the Goose Island/North Branch distribution development), chosen to be genuinely close to the watchlist events above. An earlier version of this file used 3 suburban logistics parks 50-90 min away, which capped every event's proximity score low regardless of the actual signal.

events.note: Old Navy — 1730 W Fullerton Ave, Chicago. Real $247,000 interior buildout permit, issued 2026-08-03. Exact-match on gate. Expected: high score, ACT_THRESHOLD crossed, outreach_draft.

Trader Joe's — 804 W Montrose Ave, Chicago. Real $700,000 buildout permit, issued 2026-03-27. Description reads "TRADER JOES" (no apostrophe) — fuzzy/edit-distance match on gate, not exact. Expected: mid score, NOTABLE crossed but not ACT.
Five Below — 1514 W 33rd St, Chicago. Real "coming soon, now hiring" temp-banner sign permit, issued 2025-08-25. Expected: low score, below NOTABLE_THRESHOLD — no recalibration, no action.

lululemon — 930 N Rush St, Chicago. Real storefront sign permit, issued 2026-06-29. Expected: high score via velocity+proximity despite a missing footprint field at Mireye — genuine evidence_gap, field_request action.
Unrelated residential porch-replacement permit, 2879 E 77th St, Chicago — no watchlist match. Expected: gate_status rejected, 0 LLM calls, 0 Mireye credits.
